annotations.title: Median rent, jeonse or sale price in a Korean area

description: Median monthly rent and deposit, jeonse deposit, or apartment sale price in an area of South Korea, from reported contracts (MOLIT). Fits questions about what rent costs in a Seoul district or Korean city, how big a jeonse deposit is, or what apartments sell for. Returns the median, the number of contracts and the month.

area.description: A place in South Korea: "Korea" for the whole country, a province or city ("Seoul", "Busan", "Gyeonggi"), or a district, city or county ("Mapo-gu", "Gangnam", "Suwon-si", "마포구").

month.description: Optional month as YYYY-MM, for apartment rent or jeonse within the last 12 months. Default: the latest complete month.

province.description: Optional. The province or city the area is in, when its name exists in more than one ("Jung-gu" is in Seoul, Busan and other cities).

size_band.description: Optional home size: under40, 40-60, 60-85 or over85 square meters. Uses new leases over the last 3 months.

transaction.description: monthly_rent (default, 월세): rent plus deposit. jeonse (전세): a large deposit and no monthly rent. sale: apartment sale price (apartments only).

name: housing_median
title: Median rent, jeonse or sale price in a Korean area
